inputs.prompt: ONE original adult woman healer, the Dewglass Restorer veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep her brown braided hair with small white flowers, the green scarf, the white embroidered long apron over layered green leaf and leather armour, the brown bark bracers, greaves and boots. On her back is a root-frame backpack carrying ONE large translucent cyan glass mushroom canopy above and behind her head, ONE round cyan dew flask hanging at screen left, and ONE flexible green hose curving from the backpack to ONE hand-held bulbous glass sprayer with a leafy flower nozzle pointing to screen right. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs: the screen-left hand holds the sprayer grip, the screen-right hand supports it under the glass chamber. Preserve the canopy, flask, hose, sprayer and the adult proportions. A calm, attentive idle that loops. She breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the dew sloshes gently in the flask, the head turns slightly and the glass canopy sways a touch with her body, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. The sprayer stays low in both hands with the flower nozzle tipped down toward the ground; the grip is never squeezed, so no mist, spores, droplets or puffs ever leave the nozzle. Both boots stay planted. No walking. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame. Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the whole glass canopy, the flask, the hose, the sprayer nozzle, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, spray mist, droplets, bubbles, magic, glow, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. The canopy stays attached to the backpack and the hose never disconnects. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the glass equipment.
